usedFor: AI for Database runs queries and workflows against your live data, and HubSpot is where sales acts on it. When a “New Workflow Run Completed” fires in AI for Database, “Create Contact” in HubSpot can add the people it found.

bestTemplate.name: “New Workflow Run Completed” in AI for Database, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A finished run carries its status and results, which is where a list of people comes from. “Create Contact” returns the created record, so you can use it straight away.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so a run whose results have none will fail. “New Workflow Run Completed” is polling and also fires for runs that did not succeed.
